chain.title: Inert Crystal
chain.desc: Mined from Inert Crystal Ore in stone and deepslate, then ground for extra yield. It is the blank crystal that every element in the mod is poured into.

chain.title: Source Altar
chain.desc: The mod's one generated structure, built in all four elemental flavours in small and medium sizes. Its chests are the head start: raw and powerful shards, the matching elemental crystal, Drenched Iron, Swift Alloy, runes, scrolls and sometimes a Pure Crystal.

chain.title: Contained Crystal
chain.desc: An Inert Crystal caged in Gold Nuggets. This is the component that lets a block hold element instead of leaking it.

chain.title: Extractor
chain.desc: A Contained Crystal in Iron. Placed on top of a natural Source it draws raw element out of the world - nothing in the mod runs until one of these is sitting on a source.

chain.title: Small Element Container
chain.desc: An Impaired Element Pipe and Glass. A small tank for one element type; the Extractor fills it and the instruments drink from it.

chain.title: Element Infuser
chain.desc: A Contained Crystal with Iron Ingots and Nuggets. It spends stored element to transmute a single item, which is the recipe type the next several steps come out of.

chain.title: White Rock
chain.desc: Infuse plain Stone. White Rock is the structural block of every instrument, shrine and slate below.

chain.title: Water Crystal
chain.desc: Infuse an Inert Crystal with water element. The four elemental crystals are the mod's real currency and each one needs its own Source to make.

chain.title: Drenched Iron
chain.desc: Iron infused with water element. The first alloy, and the material of pipes, the big container and the binder.

chain.title: Element Pipe
chain.desc: Contained Crystals and Drenched Iron. Pipes move element between containers and instruments so your extractors do not have to sit next to what they feed.

chain.title: Element Container
chain.desc: Burnt Glass, White Rock, a Contained Crystal, a pipe and Drenched Iron. The full-size tank; the reservoirs later are its purified upgrades.

chain.title: Element Binder
chain.desc: A Contained Crystal, White Rock and Drenched Iron. The mod's multi-input crafter: it binds several items and a charge of element into one result, and every shrine and alloy below is a binding recipe.

chain.title: Fire Crystal
chain.desc: Infused at a fire Source. Fire is the heat element - it drives the furnaces, the pylon and the lava shrine.

chain.title: Fire Furnace
chain.desc: A Furnace, White Rock and a Fire Crystal. It smelts on stored fire element instead of fuel, and the Fire Blast Furnace is the swift-alloy upgrade.

chain.title: Earth Crystal
chain.desc: The growth and harvest element. It powers the shrines that farm for you.

chain.title: Air Crystal
chain.desc: The speed element. Air is what makes Swift Alloy swift and what the Overload and Vacuum shrines run on.

chain.title: Swift Alloy
chain.desc: Bound from Drenched Iron, Gold, Copper, Redstone and an Air Crystal. It is the second-tier metal and gates the crystallizer, the inscriber and the improved instruments.

chain.title: Springaline Shard
chain.desc: Bind Quartz and an Amethyst Shard with a Water Crystal, or grind a Springaline Cluster grown on a budding block. Springaline is the mod's crystal glass and its light source.

chain.title: Strongly Contained Crystal
chain.desc: A Contained Crystal reinforced with Springaline and Swift Alloy Nuggets. Everything from the crystallizer upward needs one.

chain.title: Shrine Base
chain.desc: White Rock, an Inert Crystal and a pipe. A shrine is a base plus a bound elemental payload, and it works passively in a radius as long as element keeps arriving.

chain.title: Growth Shrine
chain.desc: Bind a Shrine Base with an Earth Crystal, a Water Crystal, Bone Meal, Seeds and a Diamond. It grows crops in its radius; the Harvest Shrine reaps them and the pair is the mod's first real automation.

chain.title: Gem Crystallizer
chain.desc: A Strongly Contained Crystal, White Rock and Swift Alloy. It grows the graded elemental gems - crude, fine and pristine - that the higher shrines and reservoirs demand.

chain.title: Inscriber
chain.desc: A Strongly Contained Crystal, White Rock, a Diamond and Swift Alloy. It writes runes onto slates and spells onto scroll paper.

chain.title: Rune Slate
chain.desc: White Rock and Swift Alloy. Inscribed, a slate becomes a rune you slot into an instrument to change its speed, capacity or luck. Minor slates use Drenched Iron and major slates use Fireite.

chain.title: Spell Desk
chain.desc: A Lectern, White Rock and Drenched Iron. Spells are learned here and then bound onto a staff or a scroll.

chain.title: Scroll Paper
chain.desc: Paper, an Ink Sac and Air Silk, which is String infused with air. Written at the Spell Desk it becomes a single-use scroll of any spell you know.

chain.title: Pure Infuser
chain.desc: An Infuser, a Strongly Contained Crystal, White Rock and Swift Alloy. A four-pedestal multiblock that consumes all four elements at once - the mod's endgame crafting station.

chain.title: Pure Crystal
chain.desc: Fire, Water, Earth and Air Crystals plus a Diamond in the Pure Infuser. Pure element is what the improved instruments, the purifier and the reservoirs are built around.

chain.title: Fireite
chain.desc: Bind Netherite, Swift Alloy, Springaline and a Pure Crystal. The top metal, and the material of major rune slates and the Pure Element Holder.

chain.title: Pure Rock
chain.desc: White Rock, Obsidian, Prismarine, Purpur and Fireite through the Pure Infuser. The last building material, and the marker that the mod is finished.

notes: Verified twice against elementalcraft-1.20.1-6.0.1.jar (mods.toml javafml, loaderVersion [47,) which is Forge for 1.20.1). Pass 1: 211 item models intersected with item./block. lang keys = 201 ids (item_count_in_jar). Pass 2 rebuilt 405 ids independently from blockstates, all 421 recipe jsons, 174 loot tables and 209 tag files. A NAIVE OBTAINABILITY TEST GIVES FALSE POSITIVES HERE AND WAS CORRECTED: the twelve elemental gems (crude, fine and pristine in all four elements) look unreachable because elementalcraft:crystallization recipes do not use a top-level result field - they carry a weighted outputs array, each entry being {quality, weight, result:{id}}, so a result scraper misses them. Reading data/elementalcraft/recipes/crystallization/*.json directly confirms all twelve are produced by the Gem Crystallizer from a crystal, a shard and a lower-grade gem, with pristine grades requiring a Pure Crystal. They are reachable and were not dropped. GENUINELY UNREACHABLE FROM DATA, and therefore excluded: elementalcraft:source (the natural Source block, placed by worldgen and never given as an item), elementalcraft:receptacle (no recipe of any type; per elementalcraft.page.source_displacement_plates0 it is the vessel a displaced source is moved into, and the plates that do the moving are craftable while the receptacle is not), elementalcraft:pure_ore, and elementalcraft:element_book (the Elementopedia, which Patchouli hands out rather than crafting). ORDER SOURCE: the bundled Patchouli book carries explicit category sortnums - basics 0, sources 1, instruments 2, pipes 3, advanced 4, shrines 5, shrine_upgrades 6, spells 7, jewels 8 - and within basics it orders inert_crystal, shards, contained_crystal, whiterock, springaline, lenses, gems, pureinfuser, while instruments runs small_container, extractor, evaporator, infuser, firefurnace, the water mills, container, binder, diffuser, the synthesizers, the air mills, crystallizer, inscriber, reservoir, extractor_improved, binder_improved, purifier. That matches the recipe graph and is what this chain follows. STRUCTURES: the mod generates elemental altars with chests/altar/small_* and chests/altar/medium_* loot in all four elements, which is where the raw and powerful shards and the early crystals come from; sources are gated by biome through data/elementalcraft/tags/worldgen/biome/has_sources/*. CONSENSUS CONFLICT (recipe graph preferred): moddb.json's 26 ElementalCraft entries agree closely with the graph at the start - contained_crystal, elementpipe_impaired, small_container, extractor and infuser all inside the first 0.06 - but then put elementalcraft:rune_slate at 0.096, elementalcraft:minor_rune_slate at 0.133 and elementalcraft:spell_desk at 0.145, all ahead of elementalcraft:binder at 0.155 and elementalcraft:elementpipe at 0.157. Rune Slate is White Rock plus Swift Alloy, and Swift Alloy is an elementalcraft:binding recipe that only the Binder can run; Minor Rune Slate and Spell Desk both need Drenched Iron, which is an infusion fed through pipes. The graph order is used instead. Nothing else in the consensus contradicted the graph. Variant families kept in wheels: the four elemental crystals with their blocks, holders and reservoirs; the shrines and the pylon; the rune slates and shrine upgrades; the springaline block family; and the instrument set including the improved and mill variants. Slabs, stairs, walls and the many decorative white rock and pure rock cuts are excluded.
